scope: Source-only feasibility audit; no candidate, profiling, builds, native execution or checkout edits

basis.limit: Approximate direct-span headroom only: grouped medians and component instrumentation do not bound cache side effects or component bias.

source_findings: tree.rs:454-545 legal_actions depends on builder-fixed config/root street and betting state, not card identity. tree.rs:731-746 repeats identical fresh betting states across root-board-legal runout cards, so exact menu reuse is source-feasible.

A per-builder key must retain exact to_bits() for both put and street_bet arrays and last_increment, plus street/to_act/num_raises/last_aggressor. Conservatively retain checked too; it is unused by menu generation but used by recursion. Do not merge epsilon-near amounts, signed zeros or differing state histories through rounded keys.

On misses preserve all existing f64 expression order, clamp predicates, sort_by(total_cmp), and dedup_by epsilon logic at813-818. Hits copy the exact ordered Action variants/amount bits; config and root street remain scoped to one builder.

Preserve check_budget before menu generation at558, invalid-action-count validation at561, all strict/LenientLoad entry validation at316-388, and original error messages/order. Do not cache invalid results across builds.

Keep parent-first node/actions/data_offset append and post-recursion child_indices append at557-598 unchanged. Cache only immutable menus, never node IDs/child indices/subtrees; retain intentional impossible-runout slots at724-729 for save layout.

A menu cache cannot remove recursive apply_action work, output vector growth/copies, node/terminal construction or per-node child_indices allocation. Cloning cached Vec still allocates; retaining immutable menus avoids that allocation only with added ownership/lookup cost.

max_nodes is a node cap, not a host-byte allowance. Bound actual cache keys, table capacity and retained menu bytes; decline cache growth on its own cap/allocation failure without a new solver error. Extra retained memory remains a real peak-memory cost, and must not be claimed unchanged merely because the cache is bounded.
minimum_empirical_prerequisite: Only a bounded unchanged-builder menu-only profile that separates legal_actions cost from recursion/output construction and quantifies timer/profiling overhead could justify implementation. Need credible removable menu cost above about196.47ms across frozen fixtures before lookup/ownership costs. Per-node timers may dominate tiny calls: calibrate or use fixed sparse sampling and retain all samples; counts or hit rates alone are not speed evidence. No diagnostic prepared or run here.
future_exactness_obligations: If later justified, compare complete ordered nodes/actions/children/data_size and f64 bits to the original builder, plus existing build_validation/save_compat strict-versus-legacy and budget error cases. This is an obligation, not a request to expand the harness now.
closed_overlap: No postflop legal-menu memoization proposal found in scoped research/autoresearch Markdown search for legal_actions, TreeBuilder, and action-menu/cache combinations. E005/E014/E023 training action dispatch experiments concern GPU traversal, not CPU tree menu construction. The only exact legal_actions search hit was unrelated preflop terminal-equity reuse. This is not an exhaustive claim about every historical artifact.
